Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

agentNames.description: Whether the service serves agent-name redirects. A client cannot detect it otherwise: with the feature off a name answers exactly as an unknown one.

domainPurgeGraceSeconds.description: How long a disabled domain keeps serving before its content becomes eligible for purge. Absent when the service cannot state it.

serviceDid.description: The service's own DID: the recipient a client addresses every other Trust Task to, and the issuer of this response.

serviceNames.description: The agent names the service's own DID serves, as local parts. The community name of a service that owns its domain is the empty string. Empty when it serves none.
